title: Raising Lazarus from the Dead
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child describes John 11:32-45: Mary falls at Jesus' feet, Jesus weeps, asks for the stone to be removed though Lazarus has been dead four days, prays, calls "Lazarus, come out!", Lazarus comes out bound in grave clothes, many believe; God has power over sickness and death.

floor.prerequisite: Knows Jesus raised the widow's son.
floor.question: In which town did Jesus raise the widow's son?

representations: a tomb with a stone drawn
steps: The stone is rolled away after four days.

board.do: Draw a tomb with a stone.

board.say: Why did Martha not want the stone moved?

board.do: Wait for the child to say he had been dead four days.
Write "Lazarus, come out!" and draw the stone rolled away.

misconceptions.ask: What did Jesus do when he saw Mary weeping (John 11:35)?
misconceptions.repair: Read John 11:35-36: Jesus wept and the people said "See how he loved him".

misconceptions.ask: For how many days had Lazarus been in the tomb (John 11:39)?
misconceptions.repair: Read 11:39: Martha said four days and a bad smell. He was truly dead.

misconceptions.ask: What did Jesus call out at the tomb (John 11:43)?
Who were Mary and Martha to Lazarus (John 11:1-2)?
misconceptions.repair: Read John 11:1-2 and draw the family: Lazarus with his sisters Mary and Martha at Bethany.

checks.question: How many days had Lazarus been in the tomb?
What did Jesus call out at the tomb?
